notes: The prebuilt ungoogled-chromium Orbit Browser repacks, pinned per platform by download URL and SHA-256. ungoogled-software ships official Windows and macOS builds (own release repos); there is no official generic Linux binary, so Linux is not built here (Linux users install ungoogled-chromium from their distro). Re-pin with `python3 scripts/update_chromium.py`, which reads the newest Windows/macOS releases and their checksums from GitHub.
